title: Le Tutu, five tattered numbers of Pantalon Blanc et Culotte Rouge
html_source:
This phrase is difficult to interpret.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Le Tutu refers to the book by Leon Genonceaux, a similar proto modernist novel as Ulysses and deemed indecent. It has recently been published in English. The tattered, presumably by overuse, copies of the “ White Pants and red Knickers” may refer to a pornographic publication, possibly an invention by Joyce. Accompanied by the blue telegram ,distinctively French and bearing the news of Stephen’s dying mother, they are the travel mementos from Paris; suitably blue, white and red. Curiosity to show, an indication that the contents of the telegram are far less interesting to Stephen then the exotic erotic.
